authorship: Implementation-authored held-out evaluation, observable inputs/independent arithmetic frozen before inference; not external blind human grading.
context_review: 120 newly written requests, with30true setup-driven followups and compound scope. Full raw outputs preserved. No answer keys are supplied to model/router.
